title: Rank-unimodality of one-descent composition ideals
main_result: Proved for all undilated one-descent and bitonic compositions.
proof_finite_certificate: 1,858,242 exhaustive owner/rank inputs at first missing weights 10 through 12
optional_finite_consistency_check: All 6,095 qualifying composition hosts through weight 14.
scope: All original-rank coefficients for one-descent and bitonic compositions. The general problem for every composition is wider.
authorship_statement: Both authors contributed equally as joint first authors. Zhang Zhanhe is the corresponding author.
